members.name: intents_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does it express? Pick the single best-fitting intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a newly received card, or trouble activating / reactivating a card.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account; whether children or teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch wallet with the account: setting it up, whether it is supported, it not working, or topping up through it.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs: where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card, whether the card works in ATMs (no failed withdrawal described).
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up or turn it off, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer made or received a bank transfer (for example from one of their own accounts in another country) and the balance has not changed / the money does not show up yet, even if they also ask how long transfers normally take or whether it went okay.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: The customer deposited a cheque or cash and it does not show in the balance yet or is slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary, or has trouble or is unable to send money to a particular account or beneficiary, or the customer explicitly says they were told the transfer is not allowed or not possible (a block on the payee rather than a decline), including when transfers used to work before.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or payment they made, including money sent to the wrong account by mistake.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which merchants or shops take it, whether it works everywhere.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How card delivery works: how the card will be sent, how long delivery takes, whether it can arrive by a date, express delivery, and which places cards can be shipped to (general questions, not a complaint that an ordered card is late).
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app or account, adding an existing card or a newly arrived card to the app, or getting a card that was lost and then found back into use (reactivating or re-adding it).
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card is not working in general (not tied to one purchase, ATM or contactless, and no decline mentioned), e.g. it fails everywhere or in several places, or the customer asks how to make it work.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra cost charged for paying or purchasing with the card, or for using the card; also vague complaints about hidden fees, being charged too many fees, or being fed up with fees in general and wanting to know when fees apply.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment or purchase (described with payment or purchase wording) appears that the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A complaint that a wrong or bad exchange rate was applied or charged to a payment or purchase, or a rate error is reported without mentioning a cash withdrawal.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM, or questions about ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears that the customer did not make.
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Someone else may have the card details or be using the card while the customer still has it; fraud on the card; wanting to freeze the card for safety; questions about card security.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service or cards are available in; whether customers living in a given country can sign up.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop, restaurant or online was declined, rejected or not accepted, or the card did not work when paying at a particular shop; includes payments declined repeatedly or with a new card.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM refused to give cash: the withdrawal was declined, not authorised, or the machine would not dispense, with no pending or in-progress status mentioned.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not authorise; also a vague unknown, unauthorised or mistaken charge that is not described as a payment or purchase, and wanting to dispute a charge or debit.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, what they can be used for.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal or account details such as name, address or contact information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra charges for exchanging currency (the cost of the exchange itself, not a complaint that the rate was wrong).
criteria.exchange_rate: Information questions about exchange rates: what they are, where to see them, how they are determined (not a complaint that an applied rate was wrong).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange one currency for another in the app, or whether exchange into a given currency is possible.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small extra amount of about one unit of currency (one pound, euro or dollar) on the statement or paid above the price, including when the customer does not recognise that small charge or it is pending; also being charged extra (an additional amount) when no transaction type is named.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through; error when sending money; the customer simply cannot make or complete a transfer, without saying it was declined or that they were told it is not allowed.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which (fiat) currencies the account can hold or exchange.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card, and who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card ready to use, including where to find the PIN for the card or not having received the PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an extra, additional or second card; how many cards one can have; fees for additional cards.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card, where to find it, or a virtual card that has not appeared yet.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card is currently lost or stolen and the customer needs to report or deal with that.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they need access or security.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, wanting a physical card, and the cost of a physical or new card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or login code; resetting it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending or has not completed.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending or in progress, e.g. the customer did not get their money from the machine and the transaction is still shown as in progress. Requires a pending / in-progress status.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or taking a long time.
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer that the customer says is pending or still waiting to be processed (they ask about that status); a transfer that simply has not arrived, gone through or posted yet is not enough.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or account is blocked after wrong PIN attempts.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money from other people or employers; whether others can send money to the customer or salary can be paid in.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer expects has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: How to request or get a refund for something bought, or return policy questions.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment or purchase that was made was later returned, reverted or cancelled, the money came back to the account, or the payment has disappeared and no longer shows.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card types (credit cards, card brands) and which currencies can be used to top up or add money.
criteria.terminate_account: Closing, deleting or cancelling the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up the account with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or did not work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Maximum or minimum top-up amounts, top-up limits, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up is described as reverted or returned, or a top-up that went through later disappeared from the account (when the customer does not say it was made with a card).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card, or a problem with a top-up made with a card, including money that went missing when topping up with a card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice or appears duplicated.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer, or questions about transfer fees; also a bare question about why one particular charge or fee was taken, or whether fees have gone up, when no card payment, ATM, currency exchange or top-up is named (even if the customer mentions being abroad).
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or add money into the account from another account or bank, including by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent money and it has not arrived at the destination: the recipient, payee, retailer or receiving account does not have it yet, even if it is still being processed; also complaints that a specific transfer or transaction the customer sent is taking too long to complete.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive, including incoming transfers from abroad the customer is waiting for (not a complaint that money the customer sent is slow to reach its destination).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: The customer tried to verify their identity but it failed or they cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity and which documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Showing or finding out where money in the account came from (source of funds).
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a card used for top-up; finding the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working or was rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether cards are Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them, or wanting a card of one particular network (a Visa or a Mastercard).
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed less cash than requested or the amount received was wrong.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal abroad got the wrong exchange rate.

criteria.top_up_failed: Customer intent: a top-up failed, was declined or did not work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Customer intent: maximum or minimum top-up amounts, top-up limits, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: Customer intent: a top-up is described as reverted or returned, or a top-up that went through later disappeared from the account (when the customer does not say it was made with a card).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Customer intent: how to top up using a card, or a problem with a top-up made with a card, including money that went missing when topping up with a card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Customer intent: the same payment was charged twice or appears duplicated.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Customer intent: a fee was charged on a transfer, or questions about transfer fees; also a bare question about why one particular charge or fee was taken, or whether fees have gone up, when no card payment, ATM, currency exchange or top-up is named (even if the customer mentions being abroad).
criteria.transfer_into_account: Customer intent: how to transfer or add money into the account from another account or bank, including by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer intent: the customer sent money and it has not arrived at the destination: the recipient, payee, retailer or receiving account does not have it yet, even if it is still being processed; also complaints that a specific transfer or transaction the customer sent is taking too long to complete.
criteria.transfer_timing: Customer intent: how long transfers take to arrive, including incoming transfers from abroad the customer is waiting for (not a complaint that money the customer sent is slow to reach its destination).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Customer intent: the customer tried to verify their identity but it failed or they cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Customer intent: how to verify identity and which documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Customer intent: showing or finding out where money in the account came from (source of funds).
criteria.verify_top_up: Customer intent: verifying a card used for top-up; finding the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Customer intent: a virtual card is not working or was rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Customer intent: whether cards are Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them, or wanting a card of one particular network (a Visa or a Mastercard).
criteria.why_verify_identity: Customer intent: why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Customer intent: the ATM dispensed less cash than requested or the amount received was wrong.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Customer intent: a cash withdrawal abroad got the wrong exchange rate.
